## Feature Summary

### Issues, Inbox, and Task Reliability

- Added or refined issue, Inbox, activity, task failure, and delegated-failure behavior.
- Improved task lifecycle handling, cancellation, recovery, notifications, and runtime teardown.
- Added related UI and mobile support for Inbox and failure badges.

### Agents and Runtimes

- Added Claude model discovery data and expanded agent/runtime behavior.
- Updated Codex, Hermes, Pi, Kimi, thinking, model contracts, and process/session handling.
- Added tests and fixes around tool output previews, stalled runs, and session recovery.

### Integrations and Platform

- Improved webhook and PR close checks, comments, workspace status reuse, and issue linking.
- Added or updated localization, emergency locale handling, authentication callback errors, and global error/not-found surfaces.
- Refined development listener process-group handling and OpenClaw configuration smoke coverage.

### Billing and Data

- Added billing recovery behavior and task usage/database query updates.
- Added indexes and quota/trigger metadata changes supporting autopilot and comment recovery paths.
